scoreScope: Comparative source-to-style baseline only; these scores do not judge an unsubmitted candidate.
sourceObservations: Samir is immediately identifiable by the broad yellow folded cap, blue-black scalloped hair and moustache, medium tan rounded-square face, green shirt with centered teal insert, navy lower body and dark shoe ends. Preserve that palette and identity.

The source cap is mostly a large flat cuboid with a straight shallow ledge. Its crisp flat areas and block hands/ears/nose read as assembled primitives. Short legs, narrow dark shoe ends and the shirt insert are visually compressed. These are opportunities for authorized native construction/proportion improvements, not technical locks.

The target supplies generous soft edge volumes on the cap and brim, calm rounded hair/moustache lobes, shaped nose/cheeks/palms, purposeful collar/cuffs/hem, a cleaner teal panel and cuffed navy trousers/shoes. Cap seams and restrained garment construction can survive at intended scale; target micrograin need not be copied.

The target separates tan skin, emerald green and teal under warm broad highlights with soft shaded transitions. Source lower navy tones and hair lose separation in dark areas; target suggests gentler contrast and more useful form description.

Target framing/proportions are larger than registered source; do not copy target canvas fitting, expand world height to target-pixel bounds, paint its alpha halo or treat an unseen rear view as specified. Native edits must satisfy actual capture/contact/clearance.

Native S/E/N/W frame05 pose sheets show complete heads/hair on the unseen views; they need equally deliberate soft volume and material treatment. Eating source food is actually body-occluded in N; visibility flags alone do not establish exposed pixels.
Actual main and runtime native action directions agree with the inspected legacy atlas labels for Samir. The native yaw contract remains the authority.
